Dear Atlantians,

- Nalfflan

• Fixed an issue that prevented Sage Crescent Glaive from registered on the Collection Book
• Fixed an issue that prevented Shadow Blade from registered on the Collection Book

Everyone can now log in to the game. We thank you for your patience and understanding!

Happy Gaming~
Regards,
Atlantica VALOFE Team

Greetings Atlantians!
Spring has arrived, and with it comes the enchanting bloom of cherry blossoms adorning cities and villages alike. Join us in celebrating this phenomenon at the Cherry Blossom Festival – an event open to all, where petals dance in the breeze, creating a breathtaking spectacle for everyone to enjoy!

[Event Mechanics]
Event Period: April 4, 2024 to May  9, 2024
Level Requirements: Level 60+

[Hourly Login Reward]
Players can obtain up to five rewards every hour in-game by being logged in each day during the event

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40305565/094315eb58afc1df3d6258d84f7d0de74e7f23d1.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40305565/99328cf620288c9ec06542804efaf5a10053341b.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40305565/c351ee476882536734a64c8e84a1139901d54fbc.png[/img]
Developer Note: Changes to Mercenary Auto-Battle Feature
Hello, this is the Atlantica development team. We would like to inform you about changes to the Mercenary Auto-Battle feature in this update.
Starting from this update, the Mercenary Auto-Battle feature will no longer be available. We would like to explain the reasons behind this change.
We hope that all players enjoy the game in a fair environment. The use of macros undermines the fairness of the game and can render our efforts and time futile.
Therefore, we have decided to remove the Mercenary Auto-Battle feature to prevent such unfair activities.
However, we are aware that this decision may cause inconvenience to some players. In response, we plan to provide various items related to auto-battle through events and other means. Through this, we hope that all players experience minimal inconvenience while enjoying the game and have a more enjoyable experience together.
Thank you.

notes.title: Sanctified Order of the Paladins (March 2024)
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36929673/5bd69ceb9541f54b13a2897e3241d59d28899aed.jpg[/img]

The Blessed Oath
Warrior’s blessed by the light are granted the opportunity to join the blessed order of Paladins. Knights protected under the watchful eye of the Seraph, that which brings light to the sunken and the sullied. As they raise their hearts to the Seraph, they are bound by an oath: to rid the world of all evil and to slay the shadows that spread towards the defenseless.
The Seraph is ever watchful and grant these warriors immense power as they head into battle. Paladin’s chant their prayers as they enter the fray, wielding the power of the heavens to smite their enemies and testing the faith of the unlawful.

Become the Exalted Paladin, embrace the grace of the Seraph!

[h3]Promotion Period:[/h3]
[i]March 1 to March 31 2023[/i]

[h3]Reward Insertion Period:[/h3]
[i]April 2024[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36929673/d8fe019eb5c802617b578d96839b3ebdbfb0e23c.png[/img]
1. Spend the minimum required GC to reach a tier.

2. The player will only get the items on the tier reached; other rewards that fall under the current tier will not be awarded.

3. The accumulated amount of GC will be rounded down to the nearest tier (e.g. 29996 GC will only be eligible for the 20000 GC tier).

4. After the promotion period, the rewards will be inserted directly into the player's item mall pick-up storage around April 2024.

[b]NOTE: Bonus Gcoins will not be included in the total Gcoins spent.[/b]

notes.title: Details on the Druid Changes last January 11
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40305565/ce37504548996571774264f4d5a920a3b242c10c.png[/img]


Hello there, Atlantians!

We would like to share with you a message from our development team regarding the recent update on Druid for both NA and EU Servers that was applied last January 11.

"Greetings, Atlantians!

I work in the Atlantica Development Team and I was in charge of the recent Druid revamp. Please call me MM.

The world of Atlantica is so wide and there are so many attractive mercenaries. We can travel around the world to meet them and listen to their stories but, many mercenaries are not used and only a few mercenaries are chosen.

The problems of old mercenaries are mostly the same:
1. Their magic is too weak
2. There is too little magic available

These problems make them useless. For now, we chose Druid, a friend who is easy to hire and has been by our side for a long time.

[Forest Prison]
Added combo with new magic. For the combo, it was necessary to change the existing effects, and as a result, it became a different magic than the existing ones. Unfortunately, the stun effect was deleted, but it was inevitable.

[Beast's Soul]
This is a buff skill. However, it was too ineffective for the cost of consuming the turn.
So I changed it to passive and adjusted the effect. This will have some impact on Axe-Main as well.

[Beast Claw]
Magic to deal additional damage in case of a basic attack. It is similar to that of Spartacus. Considering the concept of the axe, I thought it would be better to have powerful damage but with the trigger rate set a little lower.

[All Out]
It's active magic. If you leave [Forest Prison] on the 1st line unattended, you may regret it.

After the patch, some users are already using Druid. I've revamped Druid for the Atlantians who don't have Spartacus. But I know there are Atlantians who are using both Druid and Spartacus in their formation.

I hope this rework will make Druid more attractive and give you more choices when you set up your formations. I also hope that these changes will bring a new meta to Atlantica.

Of course, one or two mercenaries are not enough. Therefore, we plan to continue to improve old mercenaries. 

Please look forward to the next revamp. See you again!"

There you have it, everyone! We thank you for all your support and we hope to see you in the next updates.

Regards, 
Atlantica VALOFE Team

Warrior’s blessed by the light are granted the opportunity to join the blessed order of Paladins. As they raise their hearts to the Seraph, they are bound by an oath: to rid the world of all evil and to slay the shadows that spread towards the defenseless.
The Seraph is ever watchful and grant these warriors immense power as they head into battle. Paladin’s chant their prayers as they enter the fray, wielding the power of the heavens to smite their enemies and testing the faith of the unlawful.

Become the Exalted Paladin, embrace the grace of the Seraph!

[h3]Promotion Period:[/h3]
[i]July 1 to July 31 2023[/i]

[h3]Reward Insertion Period:[/h3]
[i]August 10, 2023 (CET time)[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40305565/5f03d2942c944f50592ab0fb6b4c1cc383ca0a19.png[/img]

1. Spend the minimum required GC to reach a tier.

2. The player will only get the items on the tier reached; other rewards that fall under the current tier will not be awarded.

3. The accumulated amount of GC will be rounded down to the nearest tier (e.g. 29996 GC will only be eligible for the 20000 GC tier).

notes.title: Regalia of the Lustrous Moon (May 2023)
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36929673/3038a4d825c6826d92ad8631590c755d1604c514.jpg[/img]

[h1]The Order Under the Lustrous Moon[/h1]

Legend has it of a union of wizards who have sought out the secrets of the stars. In this focus of wizardry, the veterans of this order were able to harness the moon's power and control the cosmos to win their many battles. However, this order would soon crumble after their last stand against the horde of shadows.

Centuries pass and their gear was soon unearthed. Excavators would later discover an ancient treasury housing a crescent-shaped vehicle, this would also be identified as the Grand Crescent mounted by the Moonlit Wizards during their grand battle against the horde.

Possessing the order’s gear can mean god-like power, however, are you ready to taste a fraction of the moon’s power?

[h2]Promotion Details:[/h2]

[b]Period:[/b]
[i]May 1 to May 31 2023[/i] CET Time

[b]Reward Insertion Period:[/b]
[i]June 9, 2023[/i] CET Time

[b]Mechanics:[/b]
1. Spend the minimum required GC to reach a tier.
2. The player will only get the items on the tier reached; other rewards that fall under the current tier will not be awarded.
3. The accumulated amount of GC will be rounded down to the nearest tier (e.g. 29996 GC will only be eligible for the 20000 GC tier).
4. After the promotion period, the rewards will be inserted directly into the player's item mall pick-up storage after the 1st Week of June 2023.
Note: Bonus Gcoins will not be included in the total Gcoins spent.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36929673/0241476ca6cfbe2da01f81327875b287dd4c4a12.jpg[/img]

For centuries, the authority of dragons was always challenged by many a mortal. Mankind fought against a plethora of dragons while others treat them as a respected deity.
However, there are dragons born from a fragment of origins. From the time when darkness reigned the void, to the birth of light purging the shadows. These dragons are born from beyond the cosmos.
They know not of human favor, but mankind, regardless, would fight to possess their power. Can a mere mortal simply possess this authority?

Be exalted, under the Divine Dragon’s Duality!

notes.title: New Mercenary - Natasha
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40305565/7c7f1968c824912c2f43d318f3dc67aa5c707875.jpg[/img]

Assassins …
They are all hired guns, who ensure that the kill is well worth their paycheck. Their aim is well sharpened, their blades are honed keen, and their elusiveness, perfected.

“All they ever do is kill”

…but what happens when the same assassin, is driven by a strong sense of vengeance? One who lives and breathes exacting vengeance on those who have shaped their lives into madness?

That is none other than ‘NATASHA’ an assassin driven by her vengeance on those who have ruined her familys lives. Raised to kill and only kill, Natasha is built to never stop until she secures her targets heads. With strong tenacity and precise strikes, she is not one to be underestimated.

Natasha falls under the knight class, with a dual-blade weapon type. Natasha specializes in dishing out tons of damage and making sure her targets are weakened enough for a landing blow. As ‘Plan B’ after a failed kill, she can disengage safely boosting her defensive capabilities when focused upon.

[u][b][h2]Skills Preview:[/h2][/b][/u]

[h3][b]Shadow Strike[/b][/h3]
Has a chance of summoning a shadow illusion, that deals additional damage whenever Natasha attacks.

 [img]https://media.giphy.com/media/oFzbJLomOD3gNhX1se/giphy.gif[/img]

[h3][b]Shadows Mark[/b][/h3]
Marks targets in a row using her mastery of debilitating shadows. Dealing damage, weakening their defenses and dealing damage per turn.

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/zJFOE5lddb6bgebcAW/giphy.gif[/img]

[h3][b]Blood Oath[/b][/h3]
Natasha will not stop until everyone is eliminated. Reduces incoming damage from attacks and gains resistance.

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/z4kfUHb3aioryJV33L/giphy.gif[/img]
 
[h3][b]Avenger[/b][/h3]
Empowered by the spirit of vengeance, Natashas offensive capabilities have been improved. Increasing her Attack Power, Critical, Evasion Rate and Multi-hit Rate.
 
[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/9Oa7FmC6M9dcDnE1Rq/giphy.gif[/img]

Recruit the Assassin today!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40305565/a3a0f063d9254c9dfc8ad0a46a7c585806833e57.png[/img]

[i]
Of course, she does not hire for cheap…[/i]

notes.title: Regalia of the Lustrous Moon (December 2022)
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36929673/3038a4d825c6826d92ad8631590c755d1604c514.jpg[/img]

[h1]The Order Under the Lustrous Moon[/h1]

Legend has it of a union of wizards who have sought out the secrets of the stars. In this focus of wizardry, the veterans of this order were able to harness the moon's power and control the cosmos to win their many battles. However, this order would soon crumble after their last stand against the horde of shadows.

Centuries pass and their gear was soon unearthed. Excavators would later discover an ancient treasury housing a crescent-shaped vehicle, this would also be identified as the Grand Crescent mounted by the Moonlit Wizards during their grand battle against the horde.

Possessing the order’s gear can mean god-like power, however, are you ready to taste a fraction of the moon’s power?

[h2]Promotion Details:[/h2]

[b]Period:[/b]
[i]December 01 to December 31 2022[/i] CET Time

[b]Reward Insertion Period:[/b]
[i]January 10, 2023[/i]

[b]Mechanics:[/b]
1. Spend the minimum required GC to reach a tier.
2. The player will only get the items on the tier reached; other rewards that fall under the current tier will not be awarded.
3. The accumulated amount of GC will be rounded down to the nearest tier (e.g. 29996 GC will only be eligible for the 20000 GC tier).
4. After the promotion period, the rewards will be inserted directly into the player's item mall pick-up storage after the 1st Week of December 2022.
Note: Bonus Gcoins will not be included in the total Gcoins spent.

notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36929673/831c4e14abfb2a3cbdcab80248e4b5945363f03e.png[/img]
In the Kingdom of Atlantica where the most powerful King of his Era was born named, King James IV.
At the time of his greatness, he held the most peaceful and well-established Kingdom of his generation. People in Surface World praised for being a great King. 

Then one day, an evil spirit possessed the King and bring chaos to the Kingdom of Atlantica.
One brave Knight, the Great Knight Arthur, re-unites the strongest warriors of Atlantica. After he assembles the greatest warriors of his Era. They plan to take the throne from Evil King James IV. Afterward, the bloody war began, a lot of casualties happened in the kingdom.

And then finally, Arthur and the great knights reach the throne. The King was defeated, got caught, and the Evil Spirit's sealed by braves warriors.

Time passed by, the great knights bring peace to the Kingdom. However, there is a threat that one day the Evil Spirit will return to rule again the Kingdom.

Kill all Runaway King J in the field.

notes.title: The Frozen Heart of Antark
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36929673/747e0609f3c1d5277a0ed206a972a42cab34a126.jpg[/img]

The frozen lands of Antark houses plenty of threats, all of which a common Atlantian have never dared face before. However, this doesn’t frighten curious researchers as they search for the secrets of Antark, its history and what treasures lie beneath the glaciers.
Prepare your mightiest warriors Atlantians, as we dive deep into the newest contents in the Antark Update!

[b]Entering Antark[/b]
1. Players must be Level 180 to proceed
2. Obtain the Key of Antark from the Grimm Brother's located outside the entrance
3. Getting the Key will require 1,000,000 Gold

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36929673/44ceff47c9b3099b1944c0e4635b2935b2b18a76.png[/img]

Once you've entered, you'll be met with an encampment where three personnels are stationed.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36929673/3890cd3032f8042d7e3f326faf5fb8b8c6fd29ba.png[/img]

[b]New Quests (?)[/b]
Facilitator Gigas requests the eradication of a certain spiraling dungeon. You can speak to the machine in order to get started.

However, Aaron Reisner talks of a different area; a frozen dungeon. Speak to him to learn more of this research.

[i]Note: Both quests are weekly. (Resets on Monday)[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36929673/15c9f6c4556d54fb032a75f4cb540592727df451.png[/img]

[b]Antark Outpost Shop[/b]
The captain carries essential items to assist you in your journey through Antark. But what are such items?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36929673/b65ccb0fec89890488478b711124a1d592674b2b.png[/img]

[b]A Weapon Forged from Sin[/b]
Researchers discovered of an ancient weapon known to harness the power of sin, however obtaining them will require effort, time and your blood. Your crafting skills will be put to the test.
Such weapons will require a remnant of a sin in order to reach its full potential, IF, it really is its full potential....

[u]Requirements:[/u]

- A level of crafting that surpasses normality
- Materials from the many challenges found in Atlantica
- A brilliant stone, a place inhabited by Coyote's?
- A piece of ice, from Antark perhaps?
[i](Note: You can obtain such ice from abandoned chests)[/i]

[b]The New Areas[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36929673/e7834cb4a6c843a51eb101a9c62f08fc52d10201.png[/img]

The journey to the north will be perilous, but, that is up to you to decide...

[i]~ Atlantica VALOFE Team[/i]

notes.title: Mercenary Revamp – Washington
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36929673/08d0262701ece5ddc726d12ec2e33a42d897ea26.jpg[/img]
A true patriotic servant of the nation. A battle-hardened general of the United States. The true face of comradeship. Washington carries true to his ideals of camaraderie, fighting for the sake of his fellowmen and his nation.

Washington's focus is on to bolstering his allies, buffing both their attack and defense. In addition, he has the ability to share damage amongst his team mates allowing everyone affected to take lesser hits especially in longer fights.

In a dire situation, Washington calls forth his spirit to take his place dishing out tons of damage, however, at a cost of him being severely low.

Now with the updated Patriot, his ability to buff has more potential with added effects giving more offensive capabilities for both him and his teammates as well as just a bit more power to last in fights.

[b]General Stats: Increased[/b]

[b]Battlefield Courage[/b]
Grants all allies' increased Attack Power and Defense; [b][i][ADDED][/i][/b] as well as a Heal per turn.

[b]Camaraderie[/b]
Target allies to share damage taken and reduce combo count [b][i][ADDED][/i][/b] healing them and Patriot. Target enemies to share damage among their allies and dealing additional damage when in effect.

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/FliFxQKIRMoZwx90ZG/giphy.gif[/img]

[Can be used when under Patriotic Resolve] Target allies to regain Magic Power and increase Magic Defense. Target enemies to deal devastating damage per turn in a row formation.
Target Allies:

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/8cq5W49N4nuTHQibak/giphy.gif[/img]

[u]Target Enemies:[/u]

In the Kingdom of Atlantica where the most powerful King of his Era was born named, King James IV.

notes.title: Coyote Valley
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36929673/83f47309361ca936b8d9d6b01806d52bab64bc42.jpg[/img]

Druid’s very own Coyote Valley is a challenging squad dungeon during earlier updates. One of the dungeons frequented by players in search of challenging content.

While that may be the case, it isn’t as rewarding nowadays even for mid-level players.

As such, a revamp of rewards will be included in the next update to cater to players of all levels along with some added challenges.

notes.title: Mercenary Revamp – Christine
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36929673/a74872367e03931dc9d298c93ce0487b80ea2546.jpg[/img]

The Sheriff is a fast, gun-slinging, lass continuously barraging her opponents with ranged attacks and making sure that she lands another shot with crowd control effects.

While she may attack continuously, she can be knocked out easily through hard-hitting attacks. If she happens to survive, however, sometimes her mix of attacks and crowd control can be quite lacking in overall damage.

In this next update, Christine will receive some added power along with a bit more consistency in landing her sure hits and some adjustments to her crowd control effects.

[b]Arrest[/b]
Tosses a rope that rounds up all the baddies decreasing the Action Power of the entire enemy's formation.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40305565/b94820f5fa4b72c8e1d74bb8363b7f19886a8186.gif[/img]


[b]Quick Draw[/b]
Christine gains an increased chance of triggering an extra attack.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40305565/65de1b21f8567a1dafdbf6d1de5f2aba860346d4.gif[/img]


[b]Steady Stance[/b]
Christine gains increased Combo Rate, Attack Power, Dexterity, Accuracy and Critical.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40305565/788313d991ea5c8ebf00e900771eb0c5699e84cd.gif[/img]

[b]Revolver Rush[/b]
Unleashes a rain of bullets to her enemies increasing the enemy formation's Combo Count by 1.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40305565/3ed956e8f28b17f6d9dae0c95582444384727925.gif[/img]

Christine is even more of a rootin' tootin' shootin' Sheriff. Let loose with Christine's gunslinging today!

notes.title: Mercenary Revamp – Riva Faust
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36929673/1583a6d7e00b9618d82ccd7bc27340f455295ac9.jpg[/img]

The Necromancer has been a reliable ally to Atlantians for the longest time using her skills to weaken enemies and casting her revival skill when things got tough.

However, she can be outshone nowadays by the newest supports and it’s easier to counter around her protective buffs and even her signature Resurrection skill.

For this coming update, we plan to increase her potential further as offensive debuffing support along with some added risks, yet highly rewarding effects, on her revival skill while not straying away from her defensive capabilities.


[b]Watchful Soul[/b]
Necromancer gains Evasion and buffs the entire ally formation with Defense and Magic Defense.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40305565/89108d42464782bcef39bfe3b5cb35e41bd10f33.gif[/img]


[b]Dark Mists[/b]
Increases target ally's Attack Power but reduces their Accuracy. If cast on a target enemy inflicts Silence and reduces their Accuracy.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40305565/97a63b38e4bd887056c3f3caa12eba2dcb3fdba3.gif[/img]

[b]Blood Curse[/b]
Casts a curse on a single target enemy decreasing their Action Power. Additionally, inflicts Guard Dispel and Silences them.

If target is affected by Lich's "Silence of the Grave", additionally it decreases the target's Defense.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40305565/75dcc788326851e768f7912672221b29f47479f3.gif[/img]


[b]Resurrection[/b]
Revives up to 3 allies in a column. Revived allies then gain Action Power. However, the caster dies upon activating this skill

(Cannot resurrect allies that have fallen for more than 2 turns.)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40305565/527fcb56e5ce719100502675301d6deaab47ff86.gif[/img]


The Necromancer has awakened to a new found power. Now it's up to you on how you can utilize it...

notes.title: SAE’s Grand Debut
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40305565/eebca36850290f5391f406714c4c8ca69d2e1447.jpg[/img]
In a battle, the clashing of steel and a cacophony of war cries are all that can be heard. Chants to show resilience along with the resounding war horns resonates all over the battlefield. However, this was not the case for a bubbly young lady.

She believes that life isn’t complete without an accompaniment of music and that not everything must be shrouded entirely with misfortune!
Wherever she goes, so do the hyped-up tunes she carries. Her songs give hope to all less fortunate, cheering up anyone she meets along the way. One strum of her guitar, and a sample of her song, can liven up a massive audience!

… As well as an army of Champions!

Introducing SAE, a mystical guitarist that can sway the hearts of both friends and foes! Strumming her electric guitar to both energize her allies and disorient her enemies!

Recruit SAE today, and buckle up for her explosive debut!

Will you be there at her concert?

The battle to end the Armies of the Night might take even longer than he anticipated. As such, additional mercenaries have joined to ensure the campaign’s success as the darkness have slowly spread over Southern Europe.

notes.title: Merlin's Plight
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40305565/a5dd0bdc9034c12e071eb6fff0b51c6a7217f5bd.jpg[/img]

Merlin, a wise man gifted with the powers of divination and countless arts known throughout the school of wizardry, was the famous grand wizard foretold in the Arthurian Legend and King Arthur’s loyal court mage.

His unmatched wizardry and omniscience have aided with the success of Britain; by the means of his prophecies foretelling of the nation’s future.

Under his guidance, Arthur had obtained the magical sword, which is now the young king’s sword of victory, Excalibur, that has been forged from the lush sanctuary of Avalon. With this weapon, he has vanquished countless foes and garnering victories from many a battle. 

He then took the seat as King Arthur’s humble advisor and counselor and advised to establish the knightly fellowship that we know today as the Round Table.

However, further tragedy befalls the wise man. Avalon has been corrupted by dark magic causing fairies and mystical entities to run amok ensuing chaos. Seeing this as a threat to King Arthur and the future of Britain, he immediately took action to smite the darkness despite the inevitable fate that he had envisioned: that he himself will succumb to the mysterious corruption that encased Avalon itself. 

Now tainted, Merlin, harnessing the power of the dark, has wrought havoc to Camelot. Corrupting wherever he pleased and even wounding the knights of the Round Table themselves.

Now, Atlantians, it is up to you to help King Arthur bring back and restore the sanctity of Avalon and save Merlin from the corruption. Will you bring back the kind, humble, and wise wizard of the young king? Or join the siege aiding the one consumed by darkness? 

Who will you choose?

notes.title: Atlantica Europe: Major Game Features
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36929673/f39ed771d47d5738e249c71c37cb6a92f78545c5.jpg[/img]

Let’s take a look at Atlantica Online’s major game features, to prepare you for the battles ahead!

[h1]Main Classes[/h1]

There are 3 different races in the world of Atlantica. Scion of Atlantis, Atlantian, and Hero.

[b]Scion of Atlantis[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36929673/34599851e3a249e56c63c00a3587048b6b615346.jpg[/img]

• The most flexible race with different main classes. Recommended for beginners because you can choose which class you play that suits your game style.

[h2]Melee Class[/h2]

• [b]Reaver (Axe Main)[/b] - With a sweep of your axe you strike an entire row of enemies. Your action power and defensive level against magic are low compared to others, but with your high vitality, you excel at withstanding the enemy's physical attacks.

• [b]Berserker (Power Saw Main)[/b] - With a mighty swing of your blades, your attacks strike both your target and the enemies on either side of him. This is an offensive character with high attack power.

• [b]Dragoon (Spear Main)[/b] - The reach of your spear allows you to strike two enemies in a column with high attack power.

[h2]Ranged Class[/h2]

• [b]Marksman (Bow Main)[/b] - With a bow, you become a master sniper, able to strike anyone's target in the enemy formation with high damage, and you deal even more damage with the right arrows.

• [b]Bombardier (Cannon Main)[/b] - Wielding a heavy cannon with ease, you bombard the enemies with your cannonballs, striking your foes in a cross pattern. You have high vitality. With high accuracy, you excel at knocking entire groups of enemy’s unconscious at the same time.

• [b]Rifle (Gun Main)[/b] - Ready, aim, fire! The bullets from your gun tear through the enemy defenses, hitting an entire column of foes. The enemy in front absorbs most of the damage, but you can increase your attack power by equipping special bullets.

• [b]Maestro (Instrument Main)[/b] - Your normal attacks damage two enemies in a column. Compared to other magic-using characters, you have strong physical defense due to your ability to wear light armor. You also have high Action Power for a magic user, giving you a definite edge in battle.

[h2]Magic Class[/h2]

• [b]Mage (Staff Main)[/b] - Your foes may scoff at your low vitality and defensive level, but as a mage, you have the ability to master a wide variety of spells. You can also equip an Orb, which increases your Attack Power and Intelligence.

[b]Hero[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36929673/02bf45444f20a3b503d745cda74571f63c0a25ac.jpg[/img]

• Hero race has only one class which is [b]Celestial Hunter[/b]. A master of trick shots, your arrows can hit three enemies with a single attack. When it comes to damaging your prey, there are no greater masters; whether you're casting a spell to lower enemy defense or hitting hard with a counterattack, you know how to hurt your foes.

[b]Atlantian[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36929673/2a74668c7be81c05a35969893fc255a8eac8817f.jpg[/img]

• Atlantian race is an upgraded version of Scion of Atlantis. They are the masters of each class focus on powerful attacks.

[h2]Melee Class[/h2]

• [b]Blademaster (Dual Sword Main)[/b] – With a sword on both hands, you deal damage to your target and everyone around it. Your [Static Shield] spell hurts anyone who attacks you, while [Direct Current] channels lightning through your basic attacks.

[h2]Ranged Class[/h2]

• [b]Stormcaller (Whip Main)[/b] - A terror on the battlefield, you wield your whip with deadly precision. Your physical attacks can hit a row anywhere in the enemy formation, but your true power is revealed when you reach Apotheosis: You transform into a literal goddess of lightning after you've built up your energy.

[h2]Magic Class[/h2]

• [b]Battlemage (Staff Main)[/b] - A devastating rain of lightning bolts with your staff and equip an orb to intensify your intelligence.  When you cast [Electron Field], all enemies suffer severe electric damage. You can use [Impulse] to give you and your allies a boost. At higher levels, your [Righteous Bolt] electrifies your target, then shocks nearby enemies if it dies.

[h1]Mercenary System and Recruitment[/h1]

• You can recruit mercenaries in various ways: hiring them outright, performing a recruitment Quest, buying them from the Market, winning them as an event reward, buying them from the Item Mall.

• You can find Mercenary Recruitment quest lines in-game in the quest log's Sub Quest > Recruit section.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36929673/399920ef241fb6276f36335dc0540b8f4a84114a.png[/img]
• There are also Legion mercenaries. They are 3 Legions compose of different powerful individual mercenaries.

[h2]Diabolic Legion[/h2]

-  [b]The Diabolic Legion (aka Dark Legion)[/b] is one of 3 Legions in Atlantica Online. Legion Skill is Bane of Demons. If 3 or more mercenaries from a single legion are active in your formation, and you have set your Main Legion (set this in the Legion Info window) to that legion, the Legion Skill for that Legion becomes active.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36929673/fbcb4def3b5a4ec5fe487b42a5ea6c31377c915b.jpg[/img]

[h2]Shadow Legion[/h2]

- [b]The Shadow Legion (aka Shadow Corps aka Beggar Corps)[/b] is one of 3 Legions in Atlantica Online. Legion Skill is Might of Descending Dragon. If 3 or more mercenaries from a single legion are active in your formation, and you have set your Main Legion (set this in the Legion Info window) to that legion, the Legion Skill for that Legion becomes active.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36929673/318621570a8cd00e757f1135ca1a0715a53f3c6d.jpg[/img]

[h2]Shaolin Legion[/h2]

- [b]The Shaolin Legion[/b] is one of 3 Legions in Atlantica Online. Each legion has a number of mercenaries as members. Legion Skill is Luohan Formation. If 3 or more mercenaries from a single legion are active in your formation, and you have set your Main Legion (set this in the Legion Info window) to that legion, the Legion Skill for that Legion becomes active.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36929673/1aaa66d7b1e3ce2f94aa6f10e828a7ec32c276e8.jpg[/img]

[h1]Crafting System[/h1]

• Crafting is the ability to make new items from component items. There are dozens of craft skills available to learn and no limit to how many a single player can learn at once. Craft skill ability is measured by a player's craft skill level, ranging from one to 140. The higher a craft skill level, the more items a player can craft from that discipline.

• To begin crafting a specific crafting skill you first need to either learn it from a player who has achieved "Artisan" status in that skill, or you need to buy the first level from an NPC.

• To begin crafting you need to first open the Skills window (My Info->Skills) and select a crafting skill.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36929673/814c98ff3785f402e4eb0a5f77445d1b1c85b3e0.png[/img]

• When you click on a particular skill you will see each item that you can currently craft. When you click on one of the items you will see what materials it needs and how many you have. Once you have the materials required to craft you can hit the Craft button.

• To acquire different crafting skills you have to go to Artisan District. There are variety of NPC to choose which crafting skill you want to learn.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36929673/e81052cea5790b967b58721dfd5bfcd18bf5fb62.png[/img] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36929673/a0e30246fca52b0a1e9ed81a8ceb1fa9cb0c1092.png[/img] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36929673/b5080c7b168bac0923a095fe67f2fd3d6b6dc8d6.png[/img]

[h1]Battle System[/h1]

• When you move your cursor over a monster the icon will change into a Sword. When you Left-Click on a nearby monster you will enter Battle Mode. You also can join a battle with a monster that is already in battle with another player if you belong to the same Guild or Nation as that player or are a friend.

• When right-clicking on the monster, it displays the number of monster objects, its level and battle array. (Available only when using a Patrol License).

- Right-Click on a monster and select 'Details', you can view its level and Battle Formation. (Available only if using a Patrol License)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36929673/2fbf709c0dfde96f477ad5055f2f697c75cc4552.png[/img]

If the monster is already in battle with another player, you will also see the option to 'Observe' which will allow you to watch the battle without participating in it.
The color of a Monster's Name is based on the level difference between your character and the monster:

-	If the monster is 10 or more levels below your character's level, its name will be [b]Dark Blue[/b].
-	If the monster is 7 or more levels below your character's level, its name will be [b]Light Blue[/b].
-	If the monster is close to your character's level its name will be [b]White[/b].
-	If a monster is 4 or more levels above your character's level, its name will be [b]Orange[/b].
-	If a monster is 7 or more levels above your character's level, its name will be [b]Dark Orange[/b].
-	If a monster is 10 or more levels above your character's level, its name will be [b]Red[/b].

• During your turn, you can act by choosing one of the following options:
-	Attack - Deals physical damage to the enemy.
-	Search - Gets you items by searching the dead. You won't always get treasure from the fallen, though.
-	Guard - Blocks against enemies' attacks and decreases damage by a certain amount.
-	Move - Changes a mercenary's position in your formation.
-	Wait - Causes a mercenary to do nothing. This does not use their action power.
-	Magic - Orders the mercenary to use a spell they know. You can learn one magic spell per upgrade. The highest magic level is between 40 - 80, depending on the spell and upgrade status.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36929673/cb7f90df4082d0bb0de719f782a133c4115d9699.png[/img]

• Time Limit - Both you and the enemy alternate turns to attack. Each turn is up to 30 seconds. For PVP, the number of active mercenaries is increased by one each turn. The first player can use one mercenary, the next player gets two, then the first player gets three. A maximum of 5 mercenaries can act each turn.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36929673/b0fa1a494fa2ab95ff4aa1cc940517c17a15ad0f.png[/img]

• Mercenary Formation - When a mercenary or character's position is a disadvantage during battle, or when you try to change the battle array of your mercenaries for strategy, then you can change the mercenary's position. There are 2 ways of doing this:

• [b]During Battle[/b]
On the battle menu at the right side on the bottom, if you click the move button (shortcut key D), and move to the desired position, the mercenary will move to that position, Mercenaries' action power is consumed when they change positions.

• [b]Outside of Battle[/b]
You can select Formation from the My Info menu at the top of the screen. Click the mercenary and click the position that you want it to move to. It will then move to that position.

• Action Power - Action Power (Or AP) is a measure of how many actions a mercenary can take per turn. Generally, each turn restores 25 - 150 action power depending on a mercenary's class.

In battle, action power is consumed with each action taken:
-	Attack - 100 Action Power
-	Search - 50 Action Power
-	Guard - 50 Action Power
-	Move - 50 Action Power
-	Wait - No Action Power
-	Magic - 50 or more Action Power (Depends on the magic skill)

A mercenary must have 100 action power for you to choose an action to perform. Magic also requires 100 action power to start but the amount subtracted is depended on the magic skill and its level.

When your action power is negative, you must recover 100 action power in order to move again.

• Battle System Video link (Credits to the Owner) - https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ZU_PiViM7lw.

[h1]Individual / Guild / Nation Dungeon[/h1]

[b]Individual Dungeon[/b]

• Individual Dungeons, aka Indy Dungeons aka Indies, are dungeons that are only accessible to players who use a key to access that dungeon and members of that player's party.

• Individual Dungeons have cooldown (CD) periods, during which they are inaccessible (usually 20 hours). You can view your dungeon cooldowns in your Character sheet (Alt+N) under the Dungeons tab. You can gain Dungeon Points by completing Individual Dungeons.

• Individual Dungeons are usually limited to a formation of 6 characters (Main Character + 5 Mercenaries). If a player has more than 5 mercenaries but does not manually disable at least 3 mercenaries when starting a battle in an Individual Dungeon, mercenaries will automatically be disabled at the start of each fight, starting with the lowest level mercenary and working up, until the limit is satisfied.

• Individual Dungeon Preview (Credits to KaosPolos of Sikyon) - https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0xtPgcy4e00

[b]Guild Dungeon[/b]

• Guild Dungeon is a special type of time-limit dungeon that can only be opened and entered by a Guild member, usually a Guild Leader or Guild Chief Officer. It's usually comprised of multiple floors with many mobs to kill, and since requirements for clearing tend to be rather high, squad preparation is a must.

• Once the dungeon is opened, an instance is created which lasts for two hours and is only accessible to members of the guild that opened it. A certain guild level is required to in order to use the access keys. Monsters in Guild Dungeons scale to the level of the highest Main Character in the current Party when Combat starts.

• Reward Boxes for completing Guild Dungeons are mailed to the Guild's Leader upon dungeon completion. The leader can then choose to distribute those boxes as he/she sees fit. They are typically split up evenly among participating players.

• Guild Dungeon Preview (Credits to Ladu from Argos) - https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=I20X5TkJPmY.

[b]Nation Dungeon[/b]

• Nation Dungeon is a special type of time-limit dungeon that can only be opened and entered by a Nation Officers or Leaders. It's usually comprised of multiple floors with many mobs to kill, and since requirements for clearing tend to be rather high, squad preparation is a must. Like Individual Dungeons and Guild Dungeons, there's a cool-down period once a dungeon is closed, regardless of it ending in victory or defeat.

• Some nation dungeons cannot be attempted with a full 9-character party, and so some mercenaries must be disabled by each player. Nation Dungeons reward players with Nation Tokens and Star Stones. Monsters in Nation Dungeons scale to the level of the highest Main Character in the current Party when Combat starts.

• Reward Boxes for completing Nation Dungeons are mailed to the Nation's King upon dungeon completion. The king can then choose to distribute those boxes as he/she sees fit. They are typically split up evenly among participating players.

• Avalon Nation Dungeon Preview (Credits to the nation ExcaliburforMysteria) - https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=qGR3Aw5oqwY.

[b]Titan Grand Championship[/b]

• Is a cross-server, seeded, single-elimination tournament. The tournament is open to players of division eight and above from all servers simultaneously and is held on the communal Titan server enabling cross-server competition between all participants.

• It is held twice a week on Sunday at 3 A.M. and 3 P.M. PST (11 A.M. and 11 P.M. UTC).

• Titan Grand Championship Preview (Credits to Alchemist); Final Match between Tirandill (ATNA 2019 AOWC Qualifier Champion) vs faris10 (ATNA PvP Veteran) - https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=iLAhgSYUUqY.

[h1]Real Economic System (Market)[/h1]

• Market is a central place for buying and selling items across all towns on a given server. The goods and items listed on the Market are available for purchase from any town. The market can be accessed via the Town Menu in any town.

• Buying - There is no tax for purchasing goods. When you buy something from the market, it uses the gold you have on you to pay for the item. If you do not have enough gold, you need to take more out of your bank account or earn more gold to pay for the item.

-	You can buy items from the market on the 'Buy' tab. You can find items for sale by category (e.g. Armor, Medicine, Crystal) or by just typing part of the item's name and clicking 'Search'.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36929673/16a0637b883913eb68d97ff6b1b9d503bffd4c0a.png[/img]

• [b]Crafting Materials[/b] - On the market's 'Buy' tab, if the item listed can be crafted, the Material form will list the materials to craft that item, so that you can see which you already have and how many and you can easily jump to the market listing for each of those materials.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36929673/814c98ff3785f402e4eb0a5f77445d1b1c85b3e0.png[/img]

• Equipment with Slot and Star Stones (Gem) - You can use the 'Special' button on the 'Buy' tab to search for equipment that already has Star Stones equipped. This button opens the 'Star Stone Ability Details' dialog.

-	Here you can set criteria to filter equipment search results to only show those with Star Stones that meet your criteria. For example, Star Stones with Strength bonuses.

-	Remember to close the 'Star Stone Ability Details' dialog after doing a specialized search, or it will apply the filter to your next search and the search will probably return nothing.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36929673/21071f8628854ddb1b00eba479700b45f5e4f7fa.png[/img]

• Selling - You can list as many items or stacks of items for sale on the market as you have slots available at the top of the 'Sell' tab. You get 12 sell slots until level 90, then 1 more every 10 levels.

-	Select an item or stack of items in your Inventory (you can reduce the quantity in the Qty form to sell a partial stack) and click the Register button to register the item for sale on the market. You can only sell one stack at a time of stackable items.

-	There is a tax for listing an item - this tax may vary from 1% and up. If there is a controlling guild in the town where the item is listed, 50% of the listing tax will go to that guild. So, if you are in a guild that owns a town, you should try to list items on the market while in your guild's town.

-	Once an item is sold, you will get a notification in your Notes and the money will be deposited in your bank account.

-	The maximum price for a single item is 9,999,999,999,999 gold (10 T-1) gold.

-	Over time, an unsold item that remains listed will automatically have its listing price gradually reduced.

-	If you have an item that surpasses the maximum price limit, you can sell it directly to other players via a Trade.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36929673/d3de72f352aab77f66873155c5a51e703e8eb819.jpg[/img]

• Market Rate - The market in each town has a % rate it charges for putting items on the market. That fee goes into the town and the town's controlling guild can take out some of that gold. The controlling guild can also start the starting market rate. Most towns set their fee to 1%.

-	Higher value items automatically get higher market fees assessed. Items of value over 1,000,000,000 are assessed at 2%, over 10,000,000,000 at 3% and over 100,000,000,000 at 5% (this is the top rate).

-	Rome and Antillia, which cannot be controlled by guilds, have their market rate at 2%.
• Fixed Item Price - Some items are so crucial to the game's economy that they are offered by the game itself for a fixed amount of gold and in infinite quantity
-	For example, Growth Vial (I) and Growth Vial (II). Every single character needs many Growth Vials and Growth Vial (II) is one of the materials to craft the higher level Growth Vials.

Lots of things to digest right? That’s it for now, and see you again for an advance guide for other hardcore features of the game! Hope this article helps you in deciding your path in the future!

Stay strong Atlantians!
[b]VALOFE Atlantica Team[/b]

notes.title: Know your game: Magic Mercenaries - Class B
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40305565/d2cb15eca745d7c09a17cb0789397050338205d3.jpg[/img]
Welcome to the second series of Know Your Game! Today we will check on the Class Staff Mercenaries that will help you on your journey from low to mid-level (or retain them forever!). 
 
So, let’s start and delve into some Class Staff Mercenaries! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40305565/6417cae476b5b86047f0b77ef5e2a3b04e420a2a.png[/img]
[h1][b]Dharma[/b][/h1]
[i]A mercenary who is good as a support and can possibly heal your team. [/i]
 
The Dharma is a mercenary who has high [Intelligence] and can shield and awaken your team. He can restore the Main´s health and increase his defense.

[h3][b]Type[/b][/h3]

Class B: Mage Mercenary – Deals a Magic Attack to an opponent. Increases defense and restores health.

[h3][b]Skills / Magic[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40305565/baa0d502e4e5b08f6129cc3581fb550ae42d521e.png[/img]  [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40305565/3b7c0d87b7cf7bda9e7ebe402fd6f25e628575c6.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40305565/683fd77b9f0db159d0f2b463d1888eb3693242f2.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40305565/f3d45195df00539128be3558e8d2e2dafc8097d2.png[/img]

[b]Awakening [/b]– Wakes up stunned allies and reduces the combo counter.
[b]Holy guard[/b] – Shields allies in a row, protecting them from all magic.
[b]Protect[/b] – Increases the main character´s defense and restores health every turn. Passive magic. 
[b]Shield of Protection[/b] – Increases defense and restores health when the main character takes damage. Passive magic. 


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40305565/a9a0aba74c5080ac521049f70f9a613665125724.png[/img]
[h1][b]Elementalist[/b][/h1]
[i]A Staff mercenary who bends the weather at its will. Deal's damage and debuff melee mercenaries. [/i]

The Elementalist wields a staff weapon and is the bane of any melee opponent's existence. Her skills will prevent enemy melee mercenaries from using magic while dealing with heavy damage and decreases their attack power.

[h3][b]Type[/b][/h3]

Class B: Mage Mercenary – Deals Magic attack, Target melee mercenaries on the formation and causes them damages and debuff. 

[h3][b]Skills / Magic[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40305565/a8f277d53121a6371da53eedf7a931c6f997dc95.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40305565/9cbd12fde8d0aab378ae8577c796997c8d3cc2f5.png[/img]

[b]Freezing Atmosphere[/b] –  The Elementalist stirs up a bitter cold in the air, preventing melee mercenaries from using magic. 
[b]Blazing Earth [/b]–  The Elementalist lights the atmosphere aflame, burning melee mercenaries and decreasing their Vitality. This skill also does some damage to nearby non-melee enemies. 


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40305565/b8c57ae93f25baa54c067a27cc1bb8cc6c8df8f9.png[/img]
[h1][b]Shaman[/b][/h1]
[i]A Staff Mercenary that can be both a support and a healer for the team. [/i]
 
The Shaman Mercenary is a staff wielder whose magic ranges from healing spells to damaging hexes to chants that send your mercenaries into a Berserker rage which gives a huge boost to attack power, action power, and multi-hit rate, however; you lose control over mercenaries it affects

[h3][b]Type[/b][/h3]

Class D: Mage Mercenary – Deals Magic damage against the opponent and heals your team; increases accuracy and Multi-hit rate. 

[h3][b]Skills / Magic[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40305565/4d5353759bd7506372792d2775f3bc80b4415b65.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40305565/f0c835fcfc026d1fd63c8a3ff389c212f2305f66.png[/img]

[b]Blessing of Life [/b]– The Shaman surrounds her allies with life energy, healing them.
[b]Brutal Will[/b] –  The Shaman fills her allies with brutal energy, increasing their Attack Power and putting them into a berserk state. Berserk mercenaries automatically attack opponents.
[b]Hex of Darkness[/b] – Damage an enemy with dark power.
[b]Noble Sacrifice[/b] –  The Shaman heals all team members at the cost of her life, dying after casting.

notes.title: Beginner's Guide
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40305565/873799d2943bb2f2c6e05caa18c9ac42695b96ee.jpg[/img]
Welcome to Atlantica Online! Here are some tips directed at newbie players who want to get into the game!
[b]General Tips:[/b]
- Once you entered the world, try to get a Mentor. While doing quests with him in a LDP you earn some special rewards, that really help you with your journey
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40305565/30f6b2c71a13a6d5f80f72803bdd2fde40832e5a.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40305565/54cb63ec01b21d94cf5f8fd4d0aa1936750d7d17.png[/img]
  
- Try to go into every town you find on your journey, you receive the spawning point for later, in case you don’t have a teleport license. You can travel via traveling center, which is located in every town. 
- Map information is important to progress in the game, so make sure you get the map information for every dungeon/town you see. 
 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40305565/f24c7e35825ab47cc6d92690cbcd474639545d8a.png[/img]
- Quests have either a remote function, or can be accessed by auto-move, so in the beginning, you should just follow the given path. 
- In the first levels, selling goods you loot and doing the quests is perfectly fine. 
- After level 60 you need to go to Rome plaza and talk to the NPC Master Simon, which gives you the skill “Ancient Fury”. It’s a powerful additional AoE skill, that will kill your enemies.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40305565/934139be0244a29b61ffe1c1245fe0989e108661.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40305565/b5d7d3d0301bcea37b1c73a989e3eec2cb4597fb.png[/img]

- As soon as you hit level 60, start doing the daily quests at the NPC Mr. Camaraderie, to receive the Legion Storage, it’s like a free merc. Room for legion mercenaries. 
 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40305565/d7782010ca71ba67696471a2cd0f9f98b3cb5dff.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40305565/0a501804fdd73616864dc883ab29e6f1462a5d1c.png[/img]
 
- Join a Guild! You can only benefit from that experience. Playing together is much more fun, also other guild members could help you get into the game. You can do Guild Dungeons and even Nation Dungeons. 
 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40305565/4b52cbc12fadee948a3398aa470c698c83c4f36a.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40305565/7a341ae354b3dc9d0c918c4fe89ae6ee60f3c9cd.png[/img]  
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40305565/c4616f6db0760cca40b317fd88e6ac5ef13e69d0.png[/img]
Comment jouer au jeu: 
-	MMORPG (Massively Multiplayer Online Role-Playing Game)
-	Round-based, 9-character formation
 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40305565/17e16cf71e0cf9e83f9b846ba509d3df3fcd923d.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40305565/1b6120c7ae9d63014619df31f1b070225807b61f.png[/img]
-	Experience gets divided between the characters who actively participated in the battle
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40305565/6f20cd911f93610dc03ef9523f643a0bf9763a9d.png[/img]  
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40305565/7f6edb8b8a544e369328fa69ec0535508bd48a38.png[/img]
-	Lowest character (while being in a Party/Group aka LDP) will get extra experience
-	Flying enemies only can get hit by ranged attacks, melee attacks are ineffective, you have to kill them with magic skills or ranged basic attacks
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40305565/5623b9e3a7c831665684bf316154395854678dcc.png[/img] 
-	Death results in a penalty of 10% gold loss and some small amount of experience points
-	Blessing licenses protect you from these penalties, you receive 50% more experience and 50% more damage    
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40305565/99b755c68f2d37ef7ebf8120471bb2a080247591.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40305565/ad129e04d2c0cd7902f104896af72a8dbebccb8d.png[/img]
-	Killing monsters can result in receiving information, like item or location info
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40305565/87de5234d959cdc73a9d2d49b785dcd05717cdcf.png[/img]
-	Additional enemies can join fights
-	TBS is another function, which was implemented into the game, you enter different battlefields and get amazing rewards, also raid bosses are possible to do
-	PvP system->Free league and Colosseum League

Skills
-	Each level gained, one more skillpoint is earned
-	Skillpoints are used to improve your magic competences
-	By clicking in-game under Game-Info->Class you can choose the mercenary, or your main to check the available skills
-	It's possible to decrease skills again, if you don´t like them, as there is a huge variety of playstyles
-	Maximum skill level is 80
-	The main character will get special abilities and talents once you´ve done all three upgrade quests. Level 100, level 120, and level 130

Talents/Statistics:
-	After Level 130 Main Upgrade Quest, your main character will obtain a talent-system, all talents are different based on the main 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40305565/3e100b0b2e91b20f6abf8d13bc2ed2725e444cad.png[/img] 
-	Every main character got special perks they have at the beginning, for example, bow main got %atk, stormcaller got additional crit, etc. 
-	All characters have different statistics, which determine their performance:
-	Strength, Dexterity, Vitality, and Intelligence. Ranged characters got their priority on Dexterity, Melees on Strength, and so on. 
-	The more Vitality your character has, the more health he has
-	Intelligence statistics determine the amount of mana your character has
-	Additional statistics can be obtained with the use of Growth vials, which can be looted from Monsters  
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40305565/19c56073baf3a29110bd6c76c9292b6b9a92d7f4.png[/img]
Mercenaries:
-	Correct Formation choice is key to your success in Atlantica
-	Make sure to have a balanced team, not only consisting of one type of mercenary
-	As a beginner, you receive three free mercenary marbles
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40305565/511f51daa7a685465f9a05ee02f59cc629c20c3f.png[/img]   \
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40305565/0089921bea440a77d9b96f6b813bc750a97cc4ac.png[/img]
-	Check out our mercenary guides for further information! 😊
Link for guides: https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1232420/view/2837770551809624470

Leveling:
-	Until level 100 its recommended to follow the main questline and do some additional side quests
-	At level 100, you can begin to run some INDs (Individual dungeons) to receive better rewards or run Nation dungeons/Guild dungeons with your friends
-	Olympus tower is a great source of experience and loot gain, at level 60 you can go into a level I tower, which is 30min to grind a massive amount of experience!
-	Training center is a guild function to get nice experience
-	Later at level 125, there´s a Quest called Hermit of the blue Mountains, NPC is called Tenshin-> you get a few billions of experience and rush to level 130+ til 139 there are a lot of repeatable quests that give massive amounts of experience

So, what are you waiting for? Time to get into the game! See you soon!
Atlantica Online Team
